cards.whyItMatters: 多智能体加语言模型是量化研究中的新兴探索方向，该项目的热度说明社区对此类开源实现有较高关注度，可为研究者提供观察与比较的入口；但不构成任何投资依据。
cards.title: 多智能体大模型金融交易框架登上GitHub热榜
cards.titleEn: Multi-Agent LLM Financial Trading Framework Tops GitHub Trending
cards.whyItMattersEn: Multi-agent plus language models is an emerging direction in quantitative research, and the project's popularity indicates strong community interest in open-source implementations of this kind, offering researchers an entry point for observation and comparison. It does not constitute any investment basis.
cards.description: 该项目的核心新意在于把多个大语言模型智能体组织成协作式金融交易框架，出现在GitHub每日趋势榜上有助于开发者了解该方向的开源实现形态；其用途是提供研究与实验的参考起点，而非可直接使用的交易系统。
cards.descriptionEn: The project's novelty lies in organizing multiple large language model agents into a collaborative financial trading framework; appearing on GitHub's daily trending list helps developers see an open-source implementation in this space. It serves as a starting point for research and experimentation, not as a ready-to-use trading system.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as a multi-agent LLM-driven financial trading framework
Drew attention by entering the GitHub daily trending list
Public information is limited; no verifiable component or performance details
cards.limitationsEn: The input contains only the project title, a one-line summary, source, and timestamp, with no authors, code structure, data, backtesting, or live-trading validation. Its effectiveness, robustness, and risk controls cannot be judged; trending status does not imply technical quality or return capability.
cards.summary: TradingAgents 是一个以多智能体大语言模型为核心的金融交易框架，当日进入 GitHub Trending Daily。现有信息仅包含项目名称与一句定位描述，未提供模型结构、数据来源或回测结果。因此它更适合被理解为值得关注的开源研究方向，而不是已验证有效的交易工具。
cards.summaryEn: TradingAgents is a financial trading framework built around multi-agent large language models, and it entered GitHub Trending Daily. Available information is limited to the project name and a one-line positioning statement, with no details on architecture, data sources, or backtest results. It is therefore best understood as an open-source research direction worth watching rather than a validated trading tool.
keyPoints: 定位为多智能体大语言模型驱动的金融交易框架
项目因进入 GitHub 每日趋势榜而受到关注
公开信息有限，尚无可核验的组件与绩效细节
cards.limitations: 输入仅含项目标题、一句摘要、来源与时间，缺少作者、代码结构、数据、回测与实盘验证信息，无法判断其有效性、稳健性与风险控制能力；热度榜不代表技术质量或收益能力。

cards.whyItMatters: 法律文书标注稀缺且术语专业，无监督聚类有助于知识发现。TGSF 提供了一种不依赖专家标注的双流形融合方案，在多个法律基准上验证了语义与结构信息联合利用的有效性，并为可复现的法律文本挖掘提供了超参数分析参考。
cards.title: 主题图球面融合提升法律文书无监督聚类
cards.titleEn: Topic-Graph Spherical Fusion Improves Unsupervised Legal Document Clustering
cards.whyItMattersEn: Legal documents are annotation-scarce and terminology-heavy, making unsupervised clustering useful for knowledge discovery. TGSF offers a dual-manifold fusion approach that does not rely on expert labels, validates the joint use of semantic and structural information on multiple legal benchmarks, and provides hyperparameter analysis references for reproducible legal text mining.
cards.description: 提出 TGSF 框架，将稠密主题语义发现与文档关系图嵌入融合到联合单位超球面，用于法律文书无监督聚类。在三个法律基准上优于仅语义、仅结构及 LDA、NMF、TF-IDF 等基线，提升 NMI 与 ARI，并提供超参数敏感性诊断。
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces TGSF, a framework that fuses dense topic-semantic discovery with document relational graph embeddings on a joint unit hypersphere for unsupervised legal document clustering. It outperforms semantic-only, structural-only, LDA, NMF, and TF-IDF baselines on three legal benchmarks, improving NMI and ARI, and provides hyperparameter sensitivity diagnostics.
keyPointsEn: TGSF combines Top2Vec topic semantics with Node2Vec graph embeddings via modality-weighted concatenation on a joint unit hypersphere.
On legal document benchmarks, TGSF improves NMI from 0.606 to 0.653 on LEDGAR, from 0.228 to 0.284 on ACORD, and from 0.535 to 0.570 on CUAD.
Hyperparameter sensitivity is evaluated via 216 factorial grid configurations and 240 Bayesian/multi-objective optimization trials per dataset (720 trials total).
cards.limitationsEn: Evaluation covers only three English legal benchmarks (ACORD, CUAD, LEDGAR); generalization to other languages, jurisdictions, or document types is unknown. The method still depends on hyperparameter settings such as the number of KMeans clusters, and comparisons are limited to the listed baselines without contrast to more recent deep clustering methods; the ANOVA and Pareto diagnostics characterize sensitivity only and do not provide causal explanations.
cards.summary: 论文提出 TGSF 双流形表示学习框架，通过 Top2Vec 和 Node2Vec 分别获取主题语义与图结构表示，经 L2 归一化后在单位超球面融合，再用 KMeans 聚类。在 ACORD、CUAD、LEDGAR 三个法律基准上，TGSF 的 NMI 和 ARI 均优于语义仅、结构仅、LDA、NMF 和 TF-IDF 基线。作者还通过因子方差分析和帕累托前沿诊断刻画了超参数敏感性。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proposes TGSF, a dual-manifold representation learning framework that obtains topic-semantic and graph-structural representations via Top2Vec and Node2Vec, L2-normalizes them, fuses them on a unit hypersphere, and clusters with KMeans. On ACORD, CUAD, and LEDGAR, TGSF improves NMI and ARI over semantic-only, structural-only, LDA, NMF, and TF-IDF baselines. The authors also characterize hyperparameter sensitivity using functional ANOVA and Pareto frontier diagnostics.
cards.originalTitle: Hybrid Topic-Semantic Labeling and Graph Embeddings for Unsupervised Legal Document Clustering
keyPoints: TGSF 结合 Top2Vec 主题语义与 Node2Vec 图嵌入，在联合单位超球面上做加权拼接融合。
在法律文书基准上，TGSF 的 NMI 从 LEDGAR 的 0.606 提升至 0.653，ACORD 从 0.228 提升至 0.284，CUAD 从 0.535 提升至 0.570。
通过 216 组因子网格配置和每数据集 240 次贝叶斯/多目标优化试验（共 720 次）评估超参数敏感性。
cards.limitations: 评估仅覆盖 ACORD、CUAD、LEDGAR 三个英文法律基准，结论对其他语言、法域或文书类型的泛化性未知。方法仍依赖 KMeans 聚类数等超参数设定，且实验比较范围限于所列基线，未与更近期的深度聚类方法对比；因子方差分析与帕累托诊断仅刻画敏感性，不构成因果解释。

cards.whyItMatters: 提供了一种用序列计算置换参数存储的长程预测设计思路，并通过消融揭示前向反馈中演化的预测状态本身是主要增益来源，而非梯度传播；为资源受限场景下的预测器架构选择提供参考。
cards.title: 参数共享块式预测：序列计算换存储的新方案
cards.titleEn: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting: Trading Sequential Compute for Storage
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a design direction for long-horizon forecasting that trades sequential computation for parameter storage, and ablations reveal that the evolving forecast state in forward feedback, rather than gradient propagation, is the main source of gain; this informs predictor architecture choices under resource constraints.
cards.description: 该研究提出递归函数分解（RFD），用参数共享的紧凑算子分块顺序生成未来区间，而非一次性输出完整未来，从而以序列计算换取参数存储；在冻结长上下文跨协议对比中多数单元格误差低于十类基线。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD), which uses a compact parameter-shared operator to sequentially emit contiguous future blocks instead of forecasting the entire horizon in one pass, trading sequential computation for parameter storage; in a frozen long-context cross-protocol comparison, it records lower test error in most cells against ten baseline families.
keyPointsEn: RFD uses a parameter-shared operator to sequentially generate future blocks; the three blocks are concatenated, not added as components, and each output joins the rolling context.
Controlled experiments show that removing forward feedback hurts all four datasets, but blocking its gradients has little effect, indicating the signal comes from the evolving forecast state.
In a frozen long-context comparison, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells, but this is cross-protocol: RFD uses 512/720-step context while baselines use 96 steps.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: controlled experiments cover only four datasets and three seeds; the frozen long-context comparison is cross-protocol (RFD uses 512/720-step context, baselines only 96), so error advantages cannot be directly attributed to architecture; sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel counts; no validation across more domains or real trading scenarios is provided.
cards.summary: 事实：RFD将长程预测映射分解为三个参数共享的块预测，块占用不相交的未来区间并拼接，而非作为趋势、季节或残差分量相加；每个生成的块加入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。在三个随机种子的控制实验中，移除前向反馈会损害全部四个数据集，而阻断该反馈的梯度影响很小，表明有用信号来自演化的预测状态本身。作者观点：重新应用共享算子有稳定帮助，但效果小于加宽算子。
cards.summaryEn: Fact: RFD factorizes the long-horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions that occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components; each emitted block joins the rolling context to condition the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four datasets, while stopping gradients through it changes little, indicating the useful signal comes from the evolving forecast state itself. Author view: reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it.
cards.originalTitle: Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off
keyPoints: RFD以参数共享算子分块顺序生成未来，三块拼接而非分量相加，每块输出后并入滚动上下文。
控制实验显示：移除前向反馈损害全部四个数据集，但阻断其梯度影响很小，说明信号来自演化预测状态。
冻结长上下文对比中RFD在24个单元格中23个测试误差更低，但属跨协议比较：RFD用512/720步上下文，基线用96步。
cards.limitations: 证据边界：控制实验仅涉四个数据集与三个随机种子；冻结长上下文对比属跨协议（RFD使用512/720步上下文，基线仅96步），误差优势不能直接归因于模型架构；序列通道级执行在高通道数下比迭代基线更慢且更耗内存；未提供跨更多领域或真实交易场景的验证。

cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为持续提升医疗推理能力提供了一条不依赖人工标注的自博弈强化学习路径，有望降低医疗领域强化学习训练的数据成本，并更充分地利用丰富的临床病例文献。
cards.title: CasePlay：用病例报告自博弈强化学习提升医疗推理
cards.titleEn: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
cards.whyItMattersEn: The approach offers a self-play reinforcement learning path to continually improve medical reasoning without manual annotation, potentially reducing data costs for RL in healthcare and making better use of abundant clinical case literature.
cards.description: 针对现有医疗大模型强化学习依赖专家标注或昂贵合成数据的问题，CasePlay 提出直接利用未标注临床病例报告进行自博弈强化学习，通过知识条件化出题器和评分标准裁判推理器，缓解知识点固着与难度质量失配两个挑战，在七个医疗基准上平均提升 3.1 分。
cards.descriptionEn: To address reliance on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic data in reinforcement learning for medical LLMs, CasePlay proposes document-grounded self-play directly using unlabeled clinical case reports, with a knowledge-conditioned proposer and a rubric-judge reasoner to mitigate knowledge-point fixation and difficulty-quality mismatch, improving an SFT warm-start model by 3.1 points on average across seven medical benchmarks.
keyPointsEn: CasePlay performs document-grounded self-play directly on unlabeled clinical case reports, avoiding reliance on expert-labeled questions or costly synthetic data.
A knowledge-conditioned proposer anchors question generation to case-specific knowledge points to broaden evidence coverage and mitigate knowledge-point fixation.
A rubric-judge reasoner adds rubric-based feedback on clue integration, reasoning depth, and option quality beyond answer accuracy, guiding toward reasoning-intensive questions.
cards.limitationsEn: Evaluation is limited to seven medically related benchmarks without reported external validation across institutions, disease types, or languages; case reports may carry selection bias or incomplete records, and the quality and safety of self-play-generated questions require further scrutiny; inference cost, training stability, and clinical deployment risks are not reported in the abstract.
cards.summary: CasePlay 研究能否将未标注的临床病例报告转化为强化学习训练信号，以提升大语言模型的临床推理能力。作者指出已有自博弈方法存在知识点固着和难度质量失配两个问题，并提出知识条件化出题器与评分标准裁判推理器加以应对。实验显示该方法在七个医疗相关基准上优于现有自博弈基线，并使 SFT 热启动模型平均提升 3.1 分，其中 LiveClin 提升 6.3 分。
cards.summaryEn: CasePlay investigates whether unlabeled clinical case reports can be converted into reinforcement learning training signals to improve LLM clinical reasoning. The authors identify knowledge-point fixation and difficulty-quality mismatch in existing self-play methods and propose a knowledge-conditioned proposer and a rubric-judge reasoner to address them. Experiments across seven medically related benchmarks show gains over existing self-play baselines and a 3.1-point average improvement over an SFT warm-start model, including a 6.3-point gain on LiveClin.
cards.originalTitle: CasePlay: Self-Play Reinforcement Learning from Case Reports for Medical Reasoning
keyPoints: CasePlay 直接利用未标注临床病例报告进行文档接地自博弈，避免依赖专家标注问题或昂贵合成数据。
知识条件化出题器将问题生成锚定到病例特定知识点，以扩大证据覆盖、缓解知识点固着。
评分标准裁判推理器在答案准确性之外，增加线索整合、推理深度和选项质量反馈，引导出更具推理强度的问题。
cards.limitations: 实验仅在七个医疗相关基准上评估，未说明跨机构、跨病种或跨语言的外部验证；病例报告本身可能存在选择偏倚或记录不完整，自博弈生成问题的质量与安全性仍需进一步检验；摘要未报告推理成本、训练稳定性及临床部署风险。

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究提醒，用上市公司会计数据推断租金分享下降需谨慎：报告选择偏差与行业构成会显著影响结论，且会计比率不能直接等同于生产率或劳资分配变化。对原始论文估计的审计也表明，产出效应的精确性因估计而异，不宜一概而论。
cards.title: 上市公司营收与员工支出差距扩大，但证据受行业与报告选择影响
cards.titleEn: Revenue-Staff Expense Gap Widens in Public Firms, but Evidence Is Shaped by Sector and Reporting Selection
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study cautions that inferring declining rent-sharing from public-company accounting data requires care: reporting selection bias and sector composition can materially affect conclusions, and accounting ratios are not equivalent to productivity or labor-share changes. The audit of the original paper's estimates also shows that precision of output effects varies across estimates and should not be generalized.
cards.description: 该研究基于2015—2025年695家上市公司的7000个公司-年样本，检验人均营收与人均员工支出差距是否扩大，并分析报告选择与行业构成对该推断的影响。其新意在于揭示差距集中于金融业，且记账指标无法识别真实生产率或劳资分配。
cards.descriptionEn: Using 7,000 firm-years for 695 public companies from 2015 to 2025, the study examines whether the gap between revenue per employee and staff expense per employee has widened, and how reporting selection and sector composition affect that inference. Its contribution is showing that the gap is concentrated in financial firms and that accounting measures cannot identify real productivity or the labor-capital split.
keyPointsEn: In a fixed sample of 75 continuous staff-expense reporters, nominal revenue per employee rises 83.6% and staff expense per employee rises 51.0% from 2015 to 2025.

The decline in the staff-expense-to-revenue ratio is concentrated in financial firms; among the other 25 reporters, aggregate staff expense per employee grows slightly faster than aggregate revenue per employee.
An audit of the original paper finds some US output effects imprecisely estimated, while several Danish estimates support tighter bounds.
cards.limitationsEn: The sample covers only 695 public companies over 2015–2025, with a fixed sample of just 75 staff-expense reporters. The reporting-probability model exhibits concentrated weights, substantial two-group imbalance, and sectors without reporters, so payroll results cannot be generalized. Accounting measures cannot identify real productivity or gains allocation, and the sector-dependent results neither confirm nor overturn the original paper's causal wage and labor-share findings.
cards.summary: 研究用上市公司会计数据追踪人均营收与人均员工支出之间的差距，发现固定样本中人均名义营收增长83.6%，而人均员工支出增长51.0%。作者指出这一差距主要体现在金融企业；其他25家报告企业中，人均员工支出增速略快于人均营收。作者强调这些会计指标不能识别真实生产率或收益在劳动与资本间的分配。
cards.summaryEn: The study tracks the gap between revenue per employee and staff expense per employee using public-company accounting data. In a fixed sample, nominal revenue per employee rises 83.6% while staff expense per employee rises 51.0%. The author notes the gap is concentrated in financial firms; among the other 25 reporters, staff expense per employee grows slightly faster than revenue per employee. The author stresses that these accounting measures identify neither real productivity nor the allocation of gains between labor and capital.
cards.originalTitle: Revenue Growth and Staff Expense: A Public-Company Follow-Up to Eclipse of Rent-Sharing
keyPoints: 在75家连续报告员工支出的固定样本中，2015—2025年人均名义营收增长83.6%，人均员工支出增长51.0%。
员工支出与营收之比下降的模式集中于金融企业；其他25家报告企业中，人均员工支出增速略快于人均营收。
对原始论文的审计发现，部分美国产出效应估计不精确，而若干丹麦估计支持更紧的边界。
cards.limitations: 样本仅覆盖695家上市公司2015—2025年的数据，固定样本仅75家员工支出报告者，且报告概率模型权重集中、两组不平衡明显、部分行业无报告者，不能将工资单结果推广。会计指标无法识别真实生产率或收益分配，行业依赖的结果既不能证实也不能推翻原始论文的因果工资与劳动份额发现。

cards.whyItMatters: 该研究揭示了LLM在特定领域中的隐式安全漏洞，并提供了一种可自我进化的缓解框架，对模型安全部署具有参考价值。
cards.title: MENTOR框架：元认知自进化揭示并缓解LLM隐式领域风险
cards.titleEn: MENTOR Framework: Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
cards.whyItMattersEn: The study reveals implicit safety vulnerabilities of LLMs in specific domains and provides a self-evolving mitigation framework, offering reference value for safe model deployment.
cards.description: 研究构建了覆盖教育、金融、管理三个领域的3000条标注查询数据集，发现14个主流LLM平均越狱成功率达57.8%，并据此提出元认知驱动的自进化框架MENTOR，通过自评估、规则引导推理和选择性元认知进化循环降低攻击成功率。
cards.descriptionEn: The study introduces a dataset of 3,000 annotated queries across education, finance, and management, finds an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8% across 14 leading LLMs, and proposes MENTOR, a metacognition-driven self-evolution framework that reduces attack success rates via self-assessment, rule-guided inference, and a selective metacognitive evolution cycle.
keyPointsEn: A dataset of 3,000 annotated queries spanning education, finance, and management was constructed to evaluate implicit domain risks.
Across 14 leading LLMs, the average jailbreak success rate reached 57.8%, exposing gaps in current safety measures.
MENTOR achieves self-evolving safety alignment through metacognitive self-assessment, rule-graph distillation, and activation-level steering signals.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on the authors' 3,000-query dataset and evaluations of 14 LLMs; generalizability requires validation on more independent datasets and models. The computational overhead and practical deployment impact of the metacognitive evolution cycle are not detailed in the abstract. Specific reduction magnitudes in attack success rates are not given and require full-text verification.
cards.summary: 作者构建了3000条领域标注查询数据集，评估14个LLM发现平均越狱成功率为57.8%。作者提出MENTOR框架，结合单次规则推理与选择性元认知进化循环，修正不安全响应并蒸馏规则为激活级引导信号。实验显示MENTOR在所有测试领域降低攻击成功率并优于现有安全对齐方法。
cards.summaryEn: The authors built a 3,000-query domain-annotated dataset and evaluated 14 LLMs, finding an average jailbreak success rate of 57.8%. They propose MENTOR, which couples single-pass rule-guided inference with a selectively invoked metacognitive evolution cycle to revise unsafe responses and distill rules into activation-level steering signals. Experiments show MENTOR reduces attack success rates across all tested domains and outperforms existing safety alignment methods.
cards.originalTitle: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
keyPoints: 构建了教育、金融、管理三个领域的3000条标注查询数据集，用于评估隐式领域风险。
14个领先LLM平均越狱成功率达57.8%，暴露当前安全措施的不足。
MENTOR通过元认知自评估、规则图蒸馏和激活级引导信号实现自进化安全对齐。
cards.limitations: 证据基于作者构建的3000条查询数据集和14个LLM的评估，结论的泛化性需更多独立数据集和模型验证；元认知进化循环的计算开销和实际部署影响未在摘要中说明；攻击成功率降低幅度未给出具体数值，需查阅全文确认。

cards.whyItMatters: 该基准揭示了当前 VLM 在恢复粗略物体布局与构建完整精确度量地图之间存在显著差距，为开发通过主动感知构建可靠3D空间表征的智能体提供了定量测试平台。
cards.title: SpatialScout：评估VLM智能体主动构建3D物体地图
cards.titleEn: SpatialScout: Evaluating VLM Agents for Active 3D Object Mapping
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark reveals a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps, providing a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations through active perception.
cards.description: 新在提出一个主动物体级3D建图基准，要求视觉语言模型智能体在有限交互预算下自主探索室内场景并估计目标物体中心，弥补空间问答无法检验度量地图构建能力的不足。
cards.descriptionEn: It introduces a benchmark for active object-level 3D mapping that requires vision-language model agents to autonomously explore indoor scenes and estimate object centers under bounded interaction budgets, filling the gap that spatial question answering cannot test metric map construction.
keyPointsEn: The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets.
Evaluation uses object-scale overlap scores that also penalize missing predictions, jointly measuring localization accuracy and target coverage.
The strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with only 3.25% of targets exceeding IoU 0.9.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract reports only overall performance of frontier VLMs on SpatialScout, without detailed error analysis by subtask or scene type; results are based on 80 indoor scenes and 3,140 targets, and generalization to other scenes or object categories remains unclear; the impact of agent strategies, interaction budget variations, or sensor noise on performance boundaries is not discussed.
cards.summary: SpatialScout 是一个评估视觉语言模型（VLM）智能体主动构建物体级3D地图的新基准，包含 80 个室内场景和 3,140 个目标物体。给定物体清单、RGB 观测、相机标定和位姿，智能体需控制相机探索并估计物体中心，评测同时衡量定位精度与目标覆盖率。实验显示前沿 VLM 仍有明显局限，最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5 的平均重叠分数为 41.71%，在 IoU>0.5 和 IoU>0.9 上的目标比例分别为 47.23% 和 3.25%。
cards.summaryEn: SpatialScout is a new benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping, comprising 80 indoor scenes and 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers, with evaluation jointly measuring localization accuracy and target coverage. Experiments reveal substantial limitations: the strongest model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding IoU 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9.
cards.originalTitle: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
keyPoints: 任务要求智能体协调视角选择、跨视图关联、几何估计和地图修正，并在有限交互预算内完成。
评测使用物体尺度重叠分数，同时惩罚遗漏预测，联合衡量定位准确性与目标覆盖。
最强评估模型 Claude Opus 5.5 平均重叠分数为 41.71%，仅 3.25% 目标在 IoU>0.9 上达标。
cards.limitations: 摘要仅报告了前沿 VLM 在 SpatialScout 上的整体表现，未提供各子任务或场景类型的详细误差分析；结果基于 80 个室内场景和 3,140 个目标，向其他场景或物体类别的泛化性尚不明确；未讨论智能体策略、交互预算变化或传感器噪声对性能的影响边界。

cards.whyItMatters: AI Agent 工具通常需要较多环境配置与框架选型，若项目确实做到开箱即用，可降低个人开发者和小团队的试用门槛；但目前仅有项目自身定位表述，实际可用性需自行验证。

cards.whyItMatters: 若需比较不同智能体进化策略，RSIHub 提供共享协议与可检查的候选历史，减少重复搭建实验机制的成本，并帮助识别方法排名随设置变化、优化增益未必迁移到留出任务的现象。
cards.title: RSIHub：用可组合框架统一评测智能体进化方法
cards.titleEn: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Unified Evaluation of Agent-Evolution Methods
cards.whyItMattersEn: When comparing different agent-evolution strategies, RSIHub offers a shared protocol and inspectable candidate histories, reducing the cost of rebuilding experimental machinery and helping reveal that method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains may not transfer to held-out tasks.
cards.description: RSIHub 将智能体进化方法的执行、评估、恢复与血缘追踪抽象为共享基础设施，使研究者只需编写进化策略。其新意在于以可组合配方统一实现 AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve 与 GEPA，并在固定模型与评估器下比较；有用性体现在减少重复实验机制、保留可检查的候选历史，并让结果与评估条件绑定。
cards.descriptionEn: RSIHub abstracts execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage for agent-evolution methods into shared infrastructure, letting researchers focus on evolution policies. Its novelty lies in composing AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA via reusable recipes and comparing them under fixed model and evaluator configurations; its usefulness is reducing duplicated experimental machinery, preserving inspectable candidate histories, and tying results to evaluation conditions.
keyPointsEn: RSIHub composes reusable operators in recipes and declares mutable resources, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators so AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA can be instantiated without modifying the framework core.
The framework supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage infrastructure; evaluation stays outside the mutable surface, and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions.
Under fixed model and evaluator configurations, evaluated with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking, the largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from specific benchmarks (Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking), fixed model and evaluator configurations, and instantiations of four methods, so it cannot be generalized to all evolution methods or tasks. The 13.5 percentage point gain is only the largest observed overall pass@1 improvement; method rankings vary across settings, and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. The framework itself does not guarantee generalization of evolution policies.
cards.summary: 智能体进化方法利用执行反馈改进提示、技能、工具与编排，但实现常重复搭建实验机制。RSIHub 是开源框架，通过可复用算子与可变资源声明来组合方法，并提供执行、评估、恢复与血缘支持。作者在 Terminal Bench 2 和 τ^3 Banking 上以 MiniSWE 与 Codex 实例化四种方法；事实是观察到最大整体 pass@1 提升 13.5 个百分点，作者观点是这提供了比较进化策略的公共协议。
cards.summaryEn: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. RSIHub is an open-source framework that composes methods via reusable operators and mutable resource declarations, supplying execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. The authors instantiate four methods with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking; the fact is a largest observed overall pass@1 gain of 13.5 percentage points, and the authors' view is that this provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies.
cards.originalTitle: RSIHub: A Composable Framework for Agent-Evolution Methods
keyPoints: RSIHub 以配方组合可复用算子并声明可变资源，将方法特定逻辑留在配方与算子中，不修改框架核心即可实例化 AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve 和 GEPA。
框架提供执行、评估、恢复与血缘基础设施，评估位于可变表面之外，结果与候选及评估条件保持关联。
在固定模型与评估器配置下，使用 MiniSWE 和 Codex 在 Terminal Bench 2 与 τ^3 Banking 上评测，最大整体 pass@1 增益为 13.5 个百分点。
cards.limitations: 证据来自特定基准（Terminal Bench 2、τ^3 Banking）、固定模型与评估器配置以及四种方法的实例化，不能外推为所有进化方法或所有任务上的普遍结论。最大 13.5 个百分点增益仅为观察到的整体 pass@1 提升，方法排名随设置变化，且优化增益不总是迁移到留出任务；框架本身不保证进化策略的泛化性。

cards.whyItMatters: 受监管场景对数据质量的追溯性与问责性要求更高，而大模型时代的自动化进一步抬高了这一预期；把规则当作可审计工件，有助于让质量检查与政策意图对齐并可回放核查。
cards.title: 可审计数据质量层：智能体规则发现初探
cards.titleEn: An Auditable Data-Quality Layer via Agentic Rule Discovery
cards.whyItMattersEn: Regulated settings demand traceability and accountability for data quality, and LLM-era automation raises these expectations further; treating rules as auditable artifacts helps align quality checks with policy intent and supports replay-based review.
cards.description: 提出以本体为根基、仓库原生的数据质量层构想，将质量规则作为可版本化、可追溯、可重放的一等工件，并给出其智能体规则发现核心的具体实现与初步评估框架。
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes an ontology-grounded, repository-native data-quality layer that treats quality rules as versioned, provenance-linked, replayable first-class artifacts, and presents a concrete implementation of its agentic rule-discovery core with a preliminary evaluation framework.
keyPointsEn: Proposes an ontology-grounded, repository-native data-quality layer where rules are versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and replayable via immutable execution traces.
Implements an agentic rule-discovery core with two acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop review interface.
Reports preliminary experiments on one finance and one retail dataset comparing autonomous rule discovery with human-expert rules in quality and diversity.
cards.limitationsEn: The authors explicitly describe the experiments as preliminary, covering only two real datasets in finance and retail and representing just a first step toward the vision. Whether autonomous rules match expert rules in quality and diversity requires broader validation, and evidence for the remaining components of the audit layer and wider domains is not provided here.
cards.summary: 作者指出高风险的表格数据流水线依赖分散且静态的质量检查，难以演进，也难以对照政策意图进行审计。为此提出一个将规则与治理文本溯源链接、并通过不可变执行轨迹重放的数据质量层愿景，并实现其中的智能体规则发现核心（全自主与引导两种模式）及人工复核界面。在金融和零售两个真实行业数据集上的实验仅为初步结果，用于初步检验完全自主的分治式规则发现能否产出与人类专家质量、多样性相当的规则。
cards.summaryEn: The authors observe that high-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and to audit against policy intent. They propose a data-quality layer in which rules are linked to governance texts, versioned, and replayable through immutable execution traces, and implement its agentic rule-discovery core with Full-Agentic and Guided modes plus a human-in-the-loop review interface. Experiments on two real industry datasets in finance and retail are reported as preliminary results on whether fully autonomous divide-and-conquer rule discovery matches human-expert rule quality and diversity.
cards.originalTitle: AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery
keyPoints: 提出本体支撑、仓库原生的数据质量层设计，规则具备版本化、治理文本溯源与不可变执行轨迹。
实现智能体规则发现核心，支持全自主（Full-Agentic）与引导（Guided）两种规则获取模式，并配有 HITL 复核界面。
在金融、零售两个真实数据集上给出初步实验，比较自主发现规则与专家规则的产出质量与多样性。
cards.limitations: 文中明确称实验为初步结果，仅覆盖金融与零售两个真实数据集，且只是迈向该愿景的第一步；自主规则发现与专家规则的质量、多样性比较尚需更全面验证，审计层其余组件与更广泛场景的效果未在此给出证据。

cards.whyItMatters: 编码代理已能快速生成界面，但常见结果趋于同质与套路化；若设计约束能以技能形式复用，可能帮助开发者在代理工作流中保持更高的界面质量与一致性。
cards.title: hallmark：面向编码代理的反AI粗劣设计技能
cards.titleEn: hallmark: an anti-AI-slop design skill for coding agents
cards.whyItMattersEn: Coding agents can produce interfaces quickly, but results often feel homogeneous and formulaic; reusable design constraints packaged as a skill could help developers maintain interface quality and consistency within agent workflows.
cards.description: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending Daily 上出现，自我定位为适用于 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 的反 AI 粗劣设计技能；新意在于把设计约束以“技能”形式嵌入编码代理工作流，对希望代理产出更少模板化界面的开发者可能有用。

cards.whyItMatters: 美式期权定价长期依赖 Heston 等仿射模型，该工作表明 DSINC 谱方法可覆盖更一般的随机波动率模型，为需要非仿射波动率假设的定价与校准提供了一条无需对数价格网格、精度可控的计算路径，并给出了不同模型下的实现选择。
cards.title: DSINC 方法扩展至非仿射随机波动率模型
cards.titleEn: Extending DSINC beyond Heston to Non-Affine Stochastic-Volatility Models
cards.whyItMattersEn: American option pricing has long relied on affine models such as Heston; this work shows that the DSINC spectral method can cover more general stochastic-volatility models, offering a grid-free-in-log-price computational route with controlled accuracy for pricing and calibration under non-affine volatility assumptions, and it provides implementation choices across models.
cards.description: 该研究将 DSINC 方法从仿射 Heston 类推广到一般一因子随机波动率模型，证明塌缩恒等式仍成立，并给出 3/2 模型、SABR 等模型下的变换与计算方案，从而在更广泛模型上保持期权定价精度。
cards.descriptionEn: This study generalizes the DSINC method from the affine Heston class to general one-factor stochastic-volatility models, showing that the collapse identity remains valid and providing transforms and computational schemes for the 3/2 model, SABR, and others, thereby maintaining option pricing accuracy across a broader model class.
keyPointsEn: The collapse identity remains valid for non-affine one-factor stochastic-volatility models; damping between zero and one is admissible when the discounted spot is a nonnegative local martingale.

An Itô transformation of the volatility factor factorizes the conditional characteristic function and identifies a natural coordinate for approximating the exercise boundary; the 3/2 model admits closed-form joint transforms via Kummer functions, and uncorrelated SABR admits a Bessel representation.

When a practical closed-form transform is unavailable, the volatility integral is computed by solving one backward equation per frequency without a grid in the log-price; tests show accuracy within one basis point and cost comparable to or lower than finite differences.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence is limited to the one-factor stochastic-volatility models tested (3/2, SABR, GARCH, lognormal volatility) and specific parameter settings; the accuracy comparison with finite-difference benchmarks is stated to within one basis point of the strike and does not cover multi-factor, jump, or more complex models; the Hankel implementation for uncorrelated SABR is slower, closed-form transforms are available only for some models with others requiring per-frequency backward solves; the computational cost comparison depends on the finite-difference implementation used and cannot be directly extrapolated to all numerical schemes.
cards.summary: 论文证明 DSINC 方法的塌缩恒等式对一般一因子随机波动率模型仍然成立，从而把美式期权早行积分简化为单一谱积分。作者在 3/2 模型、SABR、GARCH 和对数正态波动率模型上测试，结果与精细有限差分基准在行权价 1 个基点以内一致。作者观点是计算成本与有限差分相当或更低，但无相关 SABR 的 Hankel 实现较慢。
cards.summaryEn: The paper proves that the collapse identity underlying the DSINC method remains valid for general one-factor stochastic-volatility models, reducing the early-exercise integral to a single spectral integral. The author tests the approach on the 3/2, SABR, GARCH, and lognormal-volatility models, finding agreement with fine finite-difference benchmarks to within one basis point of the strike. The author's view is that computational cost is comparable to or lower than finite differences, except for the slower Hankel implementation of uncorrelated SABR.
cards.originalTitle: DSINC beyond Heston: the 3/2 and other non-affine stochastic-volatility models
keyPoints: 塌缩恒等式在非仿射一因子随机波动率模型中保持有效，阻尼参数在 0 到 1 之间可接受的条件是折现现货为非负局部鞅。
对波动率因子做 Itô 变换可分解条件特征函数，并识别出逼近行权边界的自然坐标；3/2 模型有 Kummer 函数闭式联合变换，无相关 SABR 有 Bessel 表示。
当缺乏实用闭式变换时，可通过每个频率求解一个后向方程直接计算波动率积分，无需对数价格网格；测试精度在 1 个基点以内，成本与有限差分相当或更低。
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于论文测试的一因子随机波动率模型（3/2、SABR、GARCH、对数正态波动率）及特定参数设置；与有限差分基准的精度比较针对行权价 1 个基点以内，未涵盖多因子、跳跃或更复杂模型；无相关 SABR 的 Hankel 实现成本较高，且闭式变换仅对部分模型可用，其余需逐频率求解后向方程；文中的计算成本比较依赖于所采用的有限差分实现，不能直接外推到所有数值方案。

cards.whyItMatters: 该工作提供了一个在物理和社会约束下评估长周期具身智能体的全栈框架与基准，强调任务更新、人类交互和执行安全等现有系统较少覆盖的维度，有助于推动具身智能体在动态真实环境中的可靠部署研究。
cards.title: TARSphere：面向长周期具身智能体的全栈框架
cards.titleEn: TARSphere: A Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work provides a full-stack framework and benchmark for evaluating long-horizon embodied agents under physical and social constraints, emphasizing dimensions such as task updates, human interaction, and execution safety that existing systems rarely cover, which can advance research on reliable deployment of embodied agents in dynamic real-world environments.
cards.description: TARSphere 提出面向机器人的全栈框架，在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，并集成具身 NPC 与受限对话；其事件驱动有限状态机依据已完成动作和传递信息更新任务状态。该框架还包含具身大脑 harness，让冻结的多模态大模型通过多级可执行技能行动，并利用观察、分层记忆和执行反馈修正决策。基于此构建的 TARSphere-Bench 包含 30 个室内场景的 360 个片段，通过五组配对条件评估感知鲁棒性、干扰适应、任务更新、人类协作和意图理解。对 8 个 MLLM 的评估显示
cards.descriptionEn: TARSphere proposes a robot-oriented full-stack framework that runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue; an event-driven finite-state machine updates task states based on completed actions and delivered information. It also includes an embodied brain harness that lets a frozen multimodal large language model act through multi-level executable skills and revise decisions using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedbac
keyPointsEn: The TARSphere framework runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue to support long-horizon tasks under physical and social constraints.

An event-driven finite-state machine updates task states from completed actions and delivered information; the embodied brain harness lets a frozen MLLM act through multi-level executable skills and revise decisions using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback.

TARSphere-Bench contains 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes and assesses perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding via five paired conditions; evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, task updates and human interaction remain challenging, and frequent collisions and falls indicate the need to evaluate execution safety beyond task success.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is bounded to a simulator environment and the selected 8 MLLMs, with no real-robot deployment; the benchmark's 360 episodes and 30 indoor scenes have limited coverage; evaluation results depend on a specific action interface and decision budget; frequent collisions and falls indicate that execution safety remains an open problem, and authors' views should be distinguished from experimental facts.
cards.summary: TARSphere 是一个面向机器人长周期具身智能体的全栈框架，在物理模拟器中运行策略并集成具身 NPC 与受限对话。其事件驱动有限状态机根据已完成动作和传递信息更新任务状态，而具身大脑 harness 让冻结的 MLLM 通过多级可执行技能行动，并利用观察、分层记忆和执行反馈修正决策。作者基于此构建 TARSphere-Bench，包含 30 个室内场景的 360 个片段，用五组配对条件评估感知鲁棒性、干扰适应、任务更新、人类协作和意图理解；对 8 个 MLLM 的评估显示通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新和人类交互仍具挑战，频繁碰撞和跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全。
cards.summaryEn: TARSphere is a robot-oriented full-stack framework for long-horizon embodied agents that runs policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. Its event-driven finite-state machine updates task states from completed actions and delivered information, while an embodied brain harness lets a frozen MLLM act through multi-level executable skills and revise decisions using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback. The authors build TARSphere-Bench with 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes to assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding via five paired conditions; evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, task updates and human interaction remain challenging, and frequent collisions and falls indicate the need to evaluate execution safety beyond task success.
cards.originalTitle: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
keyPoints: TARSphere 框架在物理模拟器中运行机器人策略，并集成具身 NPC 与受限对话，以支持物理和社会约束下的长周期任务。
事件驱动有限状态机利用已完成动作和传递信息更新任务状态；具身大脑 harness 让冻结的 MLLM 通过多级可执行技能行动，并借助观察、分层记忆和执行反馈修正决策。
TARSphere-Bench 包含 30 个室内场景的 360 个片段，通过五组配对条件评估感知鲁棒性、干扰适应、任务更新、人类协作和意图理解；对 8 个 MLLM 的评估显示通用模型可优于具身模型，任务更新和人类交互仍具挑战，频繁碰撞和跌倒表明需在任务成功之外评估执行安全。
cards.limitations: 证据边界限于模拟器环境与所选的 8 个 MLLM，未涉及真实机器人部署；基准的 360 个片段和 30 个室内场景覆盖范围有限；评估结果依赖特定的动作接口与决策预算；频繁碰撞和跌倒提示执行安全仍是待解决问题，作者观点与实验事实需区分。

cards.whyItMatters: 自动化市场中异质代理的行为差异会形成不同压力模式，统一波动率或换手率限制可能无法有效应对各类风险，行为特定监管更具针对性。
cards.title: 异质交易代理在自动化市场中的压力与表现差异
cards.titleEn: Heterogeneous Trading Agents Show Distinct Stress and Performance Patterns in Automated Markets
cards.whyItMattersEn: Heterogeneous agent behaviors in automated markets generate distinct stress patterns, so uniform volatility or turnover limits may not effectively address all risks; behavior-specific regulation is more targeted.
cards.description: 该研究用强化学习模拟三类自动交易代理，发现其市场压力模式、风险调整表现与流动性波动影响显著不同，为行为特定监管提供依据。
cards.descriptionEn: The study uses reinforcement learning to simulate three types of trading agents and finds significant differences in their market stress patterns, risk-adjusted performance, and impact on liquidity and volatility, supporting behavior-specific regulation.
keyPointsEn: Herd-followers produce the most frequent but shortest stress episodes; manipulators produce the fewest but most persistent; rational agents show the most stable rolling Sharpe ratios.
SHAP attributions link herd behavior to drawdown and cross-asset signals, manipulator behavior to short-term volatility and position state, and rational behavior to momentum.
The study conducts a pilot using hourly cryptocurrency data for AAVE, ETC, and SUI to motivate the hypotheses.
cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on modeling three agent types and a pilot with hourly cryptocurrency data, with limited sample assets and market scenarios; stress patterns and attribution results come from a simulated environment and require validation across more asset classes and real market data.
cards.summary: 研究将理性套利者、操纵者和散户羊群跟随者建模为强化学习系统，在共同环境中训练并检验其市场影响。基于加密货币小时数据的初步实验显示，三类代理在压力频率与持续时间、滚动夏普比率上存在系统性差异。作者据此提出应针对行为类型进行差异化监管，而非对波动率或换手率设统一上限。
cards.summaryEn: The study models a rational arbitrageur, a manipulator, and a retail herd-follower as reinforcement learning systems trained in a common environment to examine their market impact. Pilot experiments on hourly cryptocurrency data show systematic differences among the three agent types in stress frequency and duration, and in rolling Sharpe ratios. The authors propose behavior-specific regulation rather than uniform limits on volatility or turnover.
keyPoints: 羊群跟随者产生最频繁但最短的市场压力事件，操纵者事件最少但最持久，理性代理的滚动夏普比率最稳定。
SHAP归因显示：羊群行为关联回撤与跨资产信号，操纵行为关联短期波动与持仓状态，理性行为关联动量。
研究基于AAVE、ETC、SUI的小时加密货币数据开展试点，以验证假设。
cards.limitations: 结论基于三类代理建模与加密货币小时数据试点，样本资产与市场场景有限；压力模式与归因结果来自模拟环境，尚需更多资产类别和真实市场数据验证。

Volatility-decay strategies shorting leveraged ETFs must consider borrowing costs and rebalancing effects.
